About this site

J’s Apps brings together the Android apps made by J, a developer who publishes on Google Play as J.Biglion.

What this site does

It gives a short introduction to each app and points you to that app’s own homepage, where you can see more details and screens and go on to Google Play.

Most of the apps are small and focused on one job: a study notebook, a tool to check your phone, a calculator or a quick game to take a break.

The apps

There are 18 apps here, sorted into 5 groups by what they are for. The groups change as new apps arrive.

  • Language & culture5

    Apps for learning Korean and English expressions, Korean history for the CSAT, Western art history and the Catholic Bible with cards, quizzes and notes

    Korean Study, English Proverbs Dictionary, CSAT Korean History, Art History Note, Catholic Bible Quiz

  • Math & science5

    Apps for math and physics formulas, chemistry calculations, hands-on function and shape experiments, and resistor calculations

    Math Formula Note, Math Lab, CSAT Physics Formula Note, Chemistry Note, Resistor Calculator

  • Phone4

    Apps to check your phone, compare smartphone specs, show a cheering LED board and find Wi-Fi dead zones at home

    PhoneCheck, Phone Spec, Phone LED Board, WiFi DeadZone

  • Stocks & investing2

    A stock trade calculator for average cost and returns, and a simulator to compare investing methods in a virtual market

    Stock Trade Calculator, Stock Simulator

  • Play & relax2

    A puzzle game about bending and mixing light, and a relaxing snow globe app

    Chroma Ray, Snow Globe

How the app information is written

The descriptions on this site are written after checking each app’s homepage and its Google Play listing. Apps change with updates, so please see each app’s homepage and Google Play for the latest details.

You can read this site in 12 languages, but each app supports its own set of languages. Some apps, such as the CSAT physics, Korean history and math formula apps, are made for students preparing for Korea’s CSAT.

The icons in the list are drawn for this site to tell the apps apart. They are not the official app icons or screenshots.

Contact

For questions about an app, please use the developer contact on that app’s Google Play page. You can see all of J.Biglion’s apps on the developer page on Google Play.
